import sys,json,hashlib,subprocess,math
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import mitsuba as mi
mi.set_variant('llvm_ad_mono_polarized')
import drjit as dr
dr.set_thread_count(1)
P=Path('/mnt/d/codex/MBVAR_PRR_001_20261103/research/MBVAR_PRR_001_20261103/PHYSICAL_CAUSALITY_20261104/NEW_RT_DATA/SM0')
C=P/'CANARY_R4_194_001';z=np.load(C/'RAW.npz')
out={'checks':{},'kind':'retained raw native arithmetic replay; no solver or RF'}
off=z['offsets'];freq=z['frequencies_hz'];direct=[];full=[]
for fi,f in enumerate(freq):
 sl=slice(int(off[fi]),int(off[fi+1]))
 # Source Paths.cir carrier rotation followed by Paths.cfr(f=0) sum.
 aa=z['a'][sl].transpose(1,2,0).copy()
 shape=aa.shape
 real=mi.TensorXf(aa.real);imag=mi.TensorXf(aa.imag)
 delay=mi.TensorXf(np.broadcast_to(z['tau'][sl],shape).copy())
 phase=-dr.two_pi*mi.Float(float(f))*delay
 phase=phase-dr.two_pi*dr.floor(phase*dr.rcp(dr.two_pi))
 sin,cos=dr.sincos(phase)
 rr=real*cos-imag*sin
 ii=real*sin+imag*cos
 reduced_r=np.array(dr.sum(rr,axis=-1));reduced_i=np.array(dr.sum(ii,axis=-1))
 full.append((reduced_r+1j*reduced_i)[:,0])
 di=int(z['direct_source_index'][fi])
 direct.append((np.array(rr)+1j*np.array(ii))[:,0,di])
full=np.asarray(full);direct=np.asarray(direct)
out['checks']['native_CFR_Full_bitexact']=bool(np.array_equal(full,z['native_cfr32']))
out['native_CFR_Full_replay_maxabs']=float(np.max(abs(full-z['native_cfr32'])))
def error(a,b):
 a=a.astype(np.complex128);b=b.astype(np.complex128);phase=np.angle(a/b)
 return {'relative_l2':float(np.linalg.norm(a-b)/np.linalg.norm(b)),'magnitude_relative_l2':float(np.linalg.norm(abs(a)-abs(b))/np.linalg.norm(abs(b))),'phase_weighted_rms_rad':float(np.sqrt(np.sum(abs(b)**2*phase**2)/np.sum(abs(b)**2))),'phase_maxabs_rad':float(np.max(abs(phase)))}
out['direct_CFR32_replay_vs_archived_LoS']=error(direct,z['archive_los'])
out['full_CFR32_replay_vs_archived_Full']=error(full,z['archive_full'])
old=[]
for fi,f in enumerate(freq):
 sl=slice(int(off[fi]),int(off[fi+1]));aa=z['a'][sl].transpose(1,2,0).copy()
 values=aa[:,0,:]*np.exp(-2j*np.pi*np.float64(f)*z['tau'][sl])[None,:]
 old.append(values[:,int(z['direct_source_index'][fi])])
old=np.array(old).astype(np.complex128);f64=z['direct_f64'].astype(np.complex128);archive=z['archive_los'].astype(np.complex128)
# Phase difference of F64-vs-legacy from same raw predicts F64-vs-archive discrepancy.
observed=np.angle(f64/archive);predicted=np.angle(f64/old)
residual=np.angle(np.exp(1j*(observed-predicted)))
out['phase_precision_explanation']={'observed_phase_rms':float(np.sqrt(np.mean(observed**2))),'predicted_phase_rms':float(np.sqrt(np.mean(predicted**2))),'remaining_phase_rms':float(np.sqrt(np.mean(residual**2))),'remaining_phase_maxabs':float(np.max(abs(residual))),'legacy_vs_archive':error(old,archive)}
out['checks']['precision_phase_residual_below_3e_minus_7']=out['phase_precision_explanation']['remaining_phase_maxabs']<3e-7
R=Path('/mnt/d/codex/MBVAR_PRR_001_20261103');rel='research/MBVAR_PRR_001_20261103/PHYSICAL_CAUSALITY_20261104/NEW_RT_DATA/SM0/CANARY_R4_194_001/'
bindings={}
for f in ['RAW.npz','MANIFEST.json','ARTIFACT_HASHES.json']:
 blob=subprocess.check_output(['git','--git-dir='+str(R/'.git'),'cat-file','blob','fc224bb5af7a014c62b089a8cca71234a1b98e96:'+rel+f])
 if blob.startswith(b'version https://git-lfs.github.com/spec/v1'):
  h=next(l.split(':',1)[1] for l in blob.decode().splitlines() if l.startswith('oid sha256:'))
 else:h=hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest()
 bindings[f]=h
 assert h==hashlib.sha256((C/f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
out['published_commit']='fc224bb5af7a014c62b089a8cca71234a1b98e96';out['published_hashes']=bindings
out['checks']['published_raw_and_receipts_binding']=True
print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False))
